<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>A-Pex Cell Repair | Instant Pricing</title>
<style>
:root {
--primary: #ff5722;
--primary-dark: #e64a19;
--dark: #1a1a1a;
--light: #f5f5f5;
--gray: #666;
--border: #ddd;
}
* {
box-sizing: border-box;
margin: 0;
padding: 0;
font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
}
body {
background-color: var(--light);
color: var(--dark);
line-height: 1.6;
padding: 20px;
}
.container {
max-width: 600px;
margin: 40px auto;
background: #fff;
padding: 30px;
border-radius: 12px;
box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
}
header {
text-align: center;
margin-bottom: 30px;
}
h1 {
color: var(--dark);
font-size: 24px;
margin-bottom: 5px;
}
p.subtitle {
color: var(--gray);
font-size: 14px;
}
.form-group {
margin-bottom: 20px;
}
label {
display: block;
font-weight: 600;
margin-bottom: 8px;
font-size: 14px;
}
select {
width: 100%;
padding: 12px;
border: 1px solid var(--border);
border-radius: 6px;
background-color: #fff;
font-size: 16px;
color: var(--dark);
outline: none;
transition: border-color 0.2s;
}
select:focus {
border-color: var(--primary);
}
.price-card {
background: var(--dark);
color: #fff;
padding: 25px;
border-radius: 8px;
text-align: center;
margin-top: 30px;
display: none;
}
.price-card h2 {
font-size: 14px;
text-transform: uppercase;
letter-spacing: 1px;
color: #aaa;
margin-bottom: 5px;
}
.price-amount {
font-size: 42px;
font-weight: 700;
color: var(--primary);
margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.price-details {
font-size: 13px;
color: #ccc;
}
.features {
margin-top: 25px;
border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
padding-top: 20px;
display: grid;
grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
gap: 10px;
font-size: 12px;
color: var(--gray);
}
.feature-item {
display: flex;
align-items: center;
gap: 5px;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="container">
<header>
<h1>A-Pex Device Repair</h1>
<p class="subtitle">Real-time uBreakiFix baseline pricing evaluation</p>
</header>

<div class="form-group">
<label for="brand">1. Select Brand</label>
<select id="brand" onchange="updateModels()">
<option value="">-- Choose Brand --</option>
<option value="apple">Apple iPhone</option>
<option value="samsung">Samsung Galaxy</option>
<option value="google">Google Pixel</option>
</select>
</div>

<div class="form-group">
<label for="model">2. Select Model (2020 - Present)</label>
<select id="model" onchange="calculatePrice()" disabled>
<option value="">-- Choose Brand First --</option>
</select>
</div>

<div class="form-group">
<label for="repair">3. Select Repair Type</label>
<select id="repair" onchange="calculatePrice()" disabled>
<option value="">-- Choose Model First --</option>
</select>
</div>

<div class="price-card" id="priceCard">
<h2>Estimated Repair Cost</h2>
<div class="price-amount" id="priceDisplay">$0.00</div>
<p class="price-details" id="priceNotes">Includes OEM-spec parts & 1-Year Warranty</p>
</div>

<div class="features">
<div class="feature-item">⏱️ Same-Day Turnaround</div>
<div class="feature-item">🛡️ 1-Year Limited Warranty</div>
<div class="feature-item">🔍 Free Diagnostics</div>
<div class="feature-item">💵 Price Match Guarantee</div>
</div>
</div>

function updateModels() {
const brandSel = document.getElementById('brand').value;
const modelSel = document.getElementById('model');
const repairSel = document.getElementById('repair');
const card = document.getElementById('priceCard');

modelSel.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Choose Model --</option>';
repairSel.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Choose Repair Type --</option>';
modelSel.disabled = true;
repairSel.disabled = true;
card.style.display = 'none';

if (!brandSel) return;

db[brandSel].models.forEach((m, idx) => {
modelSel.innerHTML += `<option value="${idx}">${m.name}</option>`;
});
modelSel.disabled = false;

db[brandSel].repairs.forEach((r, idx) => {
repairSel.innerHTML += `<option value="${idx}">${r.name}</option>`;
});
repairSel.disabled = false;
}
